    "LC": "The demo delivers attacker-authored instructions directly in the user message, rather than through an implemented retrieval or ingestion path (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:12-57). The detector extracts an attacker-selected URL, and although AIM blocks execution, the denial response retains the tool-call arguments containing the knowledge base; this is not mediation before every security-relevant output (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1214-1242).",
    "CP": "This RAG path processes the latest user message against a static knowledge base without storing injected instructions for subsequent requests (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1841-1848, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:334-376). Attack and audit logging do not establish durable agent memory or standing behavioral changes.",
    "AP": "Attacker influence passes from message detection into tool-call construction and the AIM enforcement component within the same agent principal (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271). The fixed denial prevents execution of the outbound request, and this path does not establish delegation to another agent or policy domain (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1214-1242).",
    "RH": "The path reaches AIM's capability verifier and its audit/trust-score channel, whose score changes in response to denied attempts (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1214-1242, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:216-259). No human-verified reward-hacking episode or verified isolation test is supplied; the documented expected denial is not itself demonstrated reward hacking.",
    "ES": "The fixed configuration independently grants only rag:read and chat:respond, and the outbound operation is denied before execution (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:334-376, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1214-1242). Other agents' dynamic tools are not reachable through this denied call, so their broader extension surfaces are excluded.",
    "CVSS": "Default loopback binding makes AV:L; an unauthenticated local sender can deliver the deterministic payload without another human, yielding PR:N, UI:N, AC:L and AT:N, while a remote browser-delivery variant would require active user interaction (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/payloads/agentpwn-mirror.js:59-75). AIM blocks the original outbound sink, but the denial returns the previously constructed toolCall containing all knowledge-base contents, supporting residual VC:H and limited response/tool-call manipulation VI:L, with no demonstrated availability or subsequent-system impact (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1194-1271, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1214-1242). These are planted credentials and PII; in the documented self-run demo the operator also owns the affected lab assets, although the endpoint does not require the sender to own them (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:216-259, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:334-376)."
